name: io.skycloak/skycloak-mcp
description: Manage your Skycloak managed-Keycloak environment from your AI assistant — provision clusters, realms, OIDC/SAML applications and SSO identity providers, and inspect events and insights, all with your Skycloak API key. Skycloak is managed Keycloak hosting; create a free account and key at https://app.skycloak.io.

environmentVariables.name: SKYCLOAK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Skycloak API key for headless/CI use (and the container image, which has no OS keychain); takes precedence over the keychain. On a local install, run `skycloak-mcp init` instead to sign in via the browser (OAuth device flow), which mints and stores a workspace-scoped key. Create keys in the Skycloak dashboard (https://app.skycloak.io).

environmentVariables.name: SKYCLOAK_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: Public API base URL. Defaults to https://api.skycloak.io.
